source: EU Funding & Tenders Portal calls for proposals
display_title: HORIZON-CL5-2027-02-D3-24 Large scale operational validation and upscaling of state-of-the-art (Generative) AI tools and models powering a next generation digital energy system – Horizon Europe
call_module_title: HORIZON-CL5-2027-02-D3-24 Large scale operational validation and upscaling of state-of-the-art (Generative) AI tools and models powering a next generation digital energy system
executive_summary: Validates and scales secure, efficient AI on live electricity grids and demonstration sites, including real-time balancing, forecasting and a digital-twin development environment. Eligible consortium beneficiaries can receive up to 70% for for-profit beneficiaries under Horizon Europe. The indicative topic budget is EUR 20 million, with around EUR 10 million expected per project. Opening 2026-12-03, full proposal deadline 2027-03-31 at 17:00 Brussels time.
status_rationale: Work Programme Part 8, pp. 172–174, Scope and Specific conditions, funds this work, which connects to GNN4GC. Annex B permits a funded Dutch beneficiary, and the operational-grid validation scope directly supports a TSO work package, subject to the China-control restriction. The funded consortium role supports Type 1 and C1.3. Both project dates are null because the call states no start, end or duration.
